Kelix Bio is a biotechnology company focused on developing advanced biological solutions for healthcare and life sciences. It works on innovative research, diagnostics, and therapeutic technologies to improve patient outcomes. The company integrates science and technology to address complex medical challenges and support advancements in modern biotechnology and personalized medicine.
